firstMismatch.message: simple monster action requires an armed monster attacking another monster

summary: The carried egg hatch succeeds through timeout.c:hatch_egg and tamedog; the first mismatch is the later weapon attack, not egg creation. At step 1452 JavaScript stops inside mhitm.c:mattackm() because its adjacent AT_WEAP path refuses an armed monster. C continues at step 1453 with rnd(20)=14 and the Woodland-elf swinging its runed broadsword at the baby red dragon. Implement the whole partially ported mattackm() function, including both current refusals (mundetected defender and armed AT_WEAP), and complete its consumed incomplete helpers before claiming whole-function evidence.

Also cover the function’s mundetected-defender branch and its complete returned passive-attack contract because mattackm() is the selected whole function.

mattackm() consumes failed_grab() and helper results from mhitu.c, weapon.c, mon.c, and mthrowu.c; preserve their existing source-aligned implementations and expand scope if a consumed callee is incomplete.
The v50 case reaches the existing dogmove.c:dog_move() caller; no new caller adapter or session-specific mapping is needed.

evidence: Admitted v50 case challenges/cases/v50/v50-dragon-egg-carried-hatch-action-attempt1.session.json has 1755 recorded steps; its manifest sourceTrace identifies carried egg hatching at steps 1328 and 1376, then the first mismatch at step 1452 in the later armed attack.

The saved v50 baseline challenges/evaluations/baseline-e4c7bc56e-v50.json records 1452/1755 screens, 7573/10005 RNG calls, and 1452/1755 cursors matched; its source commit is e4c7bc56eb850377811e089788227269b277950d.

Focused diagnostic `/tmp/teleport-v50-dragon-egg-scan.json`, run from admitted Main 03b0395d562daf356bb7984e49324eb3fedc9236, stops at step 1452 on `UnsupportedSimpleMonsterActionError` for an armed monster attacking another monster.

C source `nethack-c/upstream/src/mhitm.c:mattackm()` sets up visibility, attacker turn state, and the attack loop; its adjacent AT_WEAP branch (406-417) selects/preserves MON_WEP, calls `mswingsm()` and `hitval()`, then falls through to the physical attack case which rolls `rnd(20 + i)` at line 441 and consumes `hitmm()` result. The recording’s next step has `rnd(20)=14 @ mattackm(mhitm.c:441)` and the runed-broadsword attack message.

JavaScript `js/mhitm.js:mattackm()` has explicit unported boundaries at lines 732 (`mundetected` defender) and 798 (armed AT_WEAP). The separate earlier starting-pet scope implemented only empty-handed fall-through and explicitly excluded actual wielded weapons; it does not cover this branch.

The whole-function selection also includes its consumed incomplete `hitmm()`/`passivemm()` results and `pre_mm_attack()` side effects, so the task must cover the functions named in `source.functions` and any incomplete consumed return dependency found during source review.

The closest v50 case, `v50-own-dragon-egg-floor-hatch-action-attempt1`, uses a floor egg laid through `lay_an_egg`; this selected case uses a carried wished three-egg stack that hatches and reschedules siblings. Its first mismatch is a subsequent armed monster attack, distinct from the floor-egg path.
